sentences.en: When I returned to the booth, I was informed that the family of the second patient had arrived.

sentences.jp: 葵は短く目を閉じ、それから扉のほうへ歩き出した。

sentences.en: Aoi closed her eyes briefly and then started walking towards the door.

sentences.jp: 夜はまだ長く、警笛は遠くでまた一つ、街の闇を切り裂きながら近づいてきていた。

sentences.en: The night was still long, and the distant sound of a police siren was approaching, cutting through the darkness of the city.
